build_policy.missing_dependency_closures: one owner per closure; no overlapping rebuild
build_policy.completion_evidence: The owning tool session terminal status. A different worker sandbox process inventory or unknown session ID is not evidence of completion.

resource_window_policy.concurrency: one finite native runner owned by integration; LEAN_NUM_THREADS=4
resource_window_policy.retry: Only exact READY source changes or changed dependencies; no blind retry of identical failure
resource_window_policy.completion: Root owns its actual exec session through terminal; source owners never launch native builds

build_policy.central_executor_policy: Integration owns the sole finite native runner and follows each actual tool session to terminal. All other workers are source-only; only integration writes authoritative results.
build_policy.ready_protocol: Each source owner may atomically write only its assigned coordination/ready/<owner>.json containing source_owner and current module SHA hashes. These are readiness notices, not build PASS certificates. Central executor may consume them without waiting for chat relay; only executor writes actual build results.
build_policy.source_fix_unlock: A source owner may withdraw READY and fix its own failed source after reading the actual designated executor child.wait terminal record: exit_code present, ended_at present, start_hash=end_hash=current SHA, latest actual terminal for that module failed, and current_build.project_inputs_start does not contain that module. No new in-flight run or explicit full-build frozen scope may include it. No process inventory or unknown session inference. Executor still owns and follows the outer tool handle to terminal; READY withdrawal precedes edits.

refinement_status_note: Task IDs locate required mathematical outputs; a file ownership entry or targeted build does not mark an entire refined task complete.
